text: Added laws/src/test/scala/eyes4s/laws/TrustRegressionSuite.scala with 18 cross-built fixtures: exact sequence/cardinality for pad, interpolation, median, and Savitzky-Golay; Engbert-Kliegl ramp and irregular timing; canonical I-DT failed-window, outlier, and expansion cases; I-VT off-screen, missing-middle, and short-run cases; occupancy mass; frame/grid conflict; half-open clamp; projected-Wasserstein counterexample; and non-vacuity. Pre-fix JVM and Scala.js runs each report Total 18, Failed 12, Passed 6. Both expose median/SG timestamps [2..7,6,7,8,9], velocity 500 versus 1000 deg/s, irregular velocity accepted, I-DT onset 10 versus 1 ms, invalid I-VT events, occupancy 0.06 versus 0.05 s, same-id conflicts accepted, clamp at excluded upper bound, and finite projection compiling as Metric. The six passing controls cover unaffected filters, I-DT outlier/expansion, I-VT short-run visibility, and non-vacuity.
